summary: The SIG blocker is fixed. Prompt 137 limits Architect writes to `docs/framework/contracts/signature.md`, which exists and is under `docs/` (Architect per Art. 6, .devai/pin/constitution.md:95), the round document, and an optional `law/adr/ADR-SIGNATURE-0001-*` (no name collision). It explicitly forbids `packages/`, which is Engineer F2 territory. It also covers the negatives of the DETRAN clinical and board adapters, mapped to typed STYNX results, and preservation of the `verifyWithdrawalEvidence` result set (137:29-32). OBX has `transactional-audit-idempotency-1.5.md` and `audit-events-api.md` in its write set (138:7-8), and both exist; its ADR declares a point supersession of CTG5. OFS only cites `Database.txIndependent` and the OBX ports without redefining data/audit/outbox (139:9-11, 27-28). Prompts 138 and 139 reserve index updates to the maestro, and plan.md item 34 records it; 137 does not repeat the rule (nonblocking). All of the previous review's nonblocking repairs are present: (1) the exact names `appendInTransaction(trx,event)` and `appendManyInTransaction` (138:24,48-49; preflight:197-201); (2) the migration preserves SENT in flight, the lease and terminal ACKs with no second send, plus an Inspector sensor (138:26-28); (3) `verify_chain` partitioned by epoch plus `audit.verify_current_epoch`, including a case with more than 1000 legacy rows (138:39-40; preflight:141-142); (4) the RR/SERIALIZABLE refusal has a fixed MESSAGE and a non-retryable error in data (138:40-41; preflight:127-129); (5) the seal via `SET LOCAL transaction_read_only = on` after the clock, mapped to `ReadOnlyViolationError`, with a local `lock_timeout` in the adapter and the existing SSE 503 (138:50-52; preflight:186-201); (6) GUC mismatch uses `STY41` → `AuditChainKeyMismatchError` before the first advisory, including in `write_command_event`, stated as self-protection (138:41-43; preflight:159-161). The write sets are disjoint: SIG {signature.md, ctg9-sig-contract.md, ADR-SIGNATURE-0001}, OBX {ctg9-obx-contract.md, ADR-OUTBOX-0002, outbox-api.md, transactional-audit-idempotency-1.5.md, audit-events-api.md}, OFS {ctg9-ofs-contract.md, ADR-MOBILE-OFFLINE-0002, offline-sync-api.md}. None writes to packages/, migrations, trace, baselines or indexes. OFS depends only on names already fixed in the preflight, so the three Architect prompts can be dispatched in parallel with no shared lock. This PASS covers only the Architect dispatch; Inspector and Engineer still need their own prompts and reviews.
